messages.content:
Inspect this flowchart image against the requested process. Identify up to 4 specific mistakes: missing stages, wrong arrow direction or branch, overlapping boxes, unreadable text. Name the visible labels involved. Do not invent an error if the image is unclear. Return a short list of concrete corrections.

Requested process:
Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Begin with "Trip begins", then "Check forecast", then the decision "Rain expected?". Its Yes branch goes to "Pack umbrella"; its No branch goes to "Pack sunglasses". Both alternative stages lead directly to "Leave home", which leads to "Trip prepared".

response.text: Trip begins is connected with Check forecast which is then connected with Rain expected? If Rain expected? is No then Pack umbrella and if Rain expected? is Yes then Pack sunglasses and if Rain expected? is Yes then Leave home. Also, Pack umbrella is connected with Pack sunglasses and if Pack umbrella is No then Trip prepared. Also, Trip prepared is connected with Pack sunglasses.
